title: Loadable Register
statement: Create a loadable 8-bit register with enable and synchronous reset. When load is asserted on a clock edge, the register captures the input data; otherwise it retains its previous value. The reset input should clear the output to zero when asserted.
module_signature: module loadable_register(input clk, input rst, input load, input [7:0] d, output reg [7:0] q);
behavior: If load is 1 on the rising edge, q <= d.
If load is 0, q holds its previous value.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous resets or combinational latches.
hint: Use one always block with both clk and rst in the sensitivity list.
